top.en: At Worlds 2022 this guy got flushed by every ADC there. Homme publicly named JDG the first seed, but he was happy just reaching the quarterfinals with no fire. In the semis [~0:Gumayusi] put up the biggest ADC gap in history, and Gumayusi even rubbed it in JDG's face that they'd find out in the bot lane why nobody wanted to face them. His Aphelios-Lulu got flattened by Lucian-Nami three games in a row, then in the last one they gave him Jhin and Karma, begging him not to lose lane, and he still got solo killed over and over. The jungler at his peak came down on Sejuani to help him, and he fed it right back and still got solo killed by Gumayusi. He wasted JDG's peak top-mid-jungle that year; with any other ADC that team was a title contender. I really hate you, I truly hate you. Your second chance was game 5 for AL last year, where your Jinx played as timid as humanly possible; any ADC with a bit of nerve gets past T1 there. Why does everyone love JiaQi while you only bring [~1:Despair]? Because since 2022 the LPL has been starving for a great ADC. Why could Gumayusi run wild at Worlds and T1 three-peat? Mostly because our region has no young ADC who can win lane. A Despair-level player being the first seed every year is just sad. On Korean forums 'Hope' is literally the word for a scrub: if someone's bad, you call them a Hope. Can you retire? I'm begging you 🙏, retire, please retire!!!!!!!!!! I'm begging you!! Retire!

notes.context: Hupu nickname for T1's ADC Gumayusi.

thread.en: How could he possibly retire when he still needs to collect his paycheck? In the 2022 Worlds, this guy was treated like a toilet by every other ADC. Homme explicitly called him out, saying that as a first seed, reaching the quarterfinals was enough for him—he had no drive. In the semifinals, he suffered the biggest ADC gap in history against Gumayusi, and Gumayusi even mocked JDG, saying, 'You'll see why we didn't want to face their bot lane in the match.' His Aphelios/Lulu got destroyed by Lucian/Nami for three games straight; in the last game, he begged for Jhin/Karma just to avoid getting crushed in lane, but he still got solo killed repeatedly. Even when 369 came down from top lane on Sejuani to help him in his prime, he just turned around and gave the kills away, still getting solo killed by Gumayusi. He wasted the peak of that JDG top-jungle-mid trio; if JDG had swapped in any other ADC that year, they could have won the title. I hate you so much, I really hate you. You got a second chance last year, and in Game 5 for AL, you turned your Jinx into [~0:nuomi]—if you had any other ADC who dared to fight, you would've beaten T1. Why does everyone like Jiaqi, while you only bring despair? Because the LPL has been suffering from a lack of a strong ADC since 2022. The reason Gumayusi can play so aggressively at Worlds and T1 can win three titles is that our region lacks young ADCs who can win lane. It’s a tragedy that someone at your level gets to be a first seed every year. On Korean forums, 'Hope' is literally the synonym for a scrub; it's so embarrassing—whenever they want to call someone trash, they say they're a 'Hope'. Can you retire now? I'm begging you, please retire! I'm begging you! Retire! You retiring would be the greatest contribution you could make to the LPL. You were given a third chance, and as a first seed, you went 0-3, didn't win a single game, and went home in the top 16. Don't let me see you in the LPL next season; if any team signs you, I'll hate on you for the rest of my life.

notes.context: A slang term used to describe a player who plays passively, lacks impact, or 'softens up' like mushy rice during high-pressure moments.

[~1:Homm] explicitly called him out, saying that as the first seed, making the quarterfinals was enough and he lacked any fighting spirit. In the semifinals, [~2:Jiandan] handed him the biggest ADC gap in history, and Gumayusi styled on him to his face, mocking JDG by saying 'you'll find out why we didn't want to face our bot lane in the match.' In the Lucian-Nami vs Ezreal-Karma matchup, he got turboed for three games straight, and even in the final game where he begged his team on Jinx and Karma not to collapse in lane, he still got brutally solo-killed over and over. In his prime, top laner 369 came all the way down on Sejuani to help him, only for him to hand over kills and still get solo-killed by Gumayusi. He wasted the peak of JDG's top-jungle-mid that year; with any other ADC, JDG could have genuinely contended for the title. I hate you so much, I really hate you. You got a second chance last year in the fifth game of the series against AL where you played Jinx and played so [~3:cowardly] to the absolute extreme. Any other ADC who had even a shred of aggression could have beaten T1. Why does everyone love [~4:Jiaqi]? And why do you only bring despair? It's because ever since 2022, the LPL has been yearning for a dominant, hyper-carrying ADC for so long. Why can [~2:Jiandan] play so aggressively at [~0:Worlds] and why has T1 won three titles in a row? The biggest problem is that our region just lacks young ADCs who can win lane. A player of Hope's caliber being our first seed every single year is just pathetic. On Korean forums, Hope is literally the designated synonym for being trash—it's so humiliating, whenever they want to call someone trash they just call them Hope. Can you please retire? I'm literally begging you 🙏, please retire, I'm begging you, please retire!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I'm begging you!! Retire! You retiring would be the greatest contribution you could ever make to the LPL! You got a third chance, and what happened? As the first seed, you went 0-3 without winning a single game and got sent packing straight to the group stage exit. Don't let me see you in the LPL next season; if any team signs you, I'll be your hater for life.

notes.context: Refers to the League of Legends World Championship.

top.en: At [~0:Worlds] in 2022, this guy got farmed like a toilet bowl by every Worlds ADC. [~1:Homm] explicitly called him out, saying that as the first seed, making the quarterfinals was enough and he lacked any fighting spirit. In the semifinals, [~2:Jiandan] handed him the biggest ADC gap in history, and Gumayusi styled on him to his face, mocking JDG by saying 'you'll find out why we didn't want to face our bot lane in the match.' In the Lucian-Nami vs Ezreal-Karma matchup, he got turboed for three games straight, and even in the final game where he begged his team on Jinx and Karma not to collapse in lane, he still got brutally solo-killed over and over. In his prime, top laner 369 came all the way down on Sejuani to help him, only for him to hand over kills and still get solo-killed by Gumayusi. He wasted the peak of JDG's top-jungle-mid that year; with any other ADC, JDG could have genuinely contended for the title. I hate you so much, I really hate you. You got a second chance last year in the fifth game of the series against AL where you played Jinx and played so [~3:cowardly] to the absolute extreme. Any other ADC who had even a shred of aggression could have beaten T1. Why does everyone love [~4:Jiaqi]? And why do you only bring despair? It's because ever since 2022, the LPL has been yearning for a dominant, hyper-carrying ADC for so long. Why can [~2:Jiandan] play so aggressively at [~0:Worlds] and why has T1 won three titles in a row? The biggest problem is that our region just lacks young ADCs who can win lane. A player of Hope's caliber being our first seed every single year is just pathetic. On Korean forums, Hope is literally the designated synonym for being trash—it's so humiliating, whenever they want to call someone trash they just call them Hope. Can you please retire? I'm literally begging you 🙏, please retire, I'm begging you, please retire!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! I'm begging you!! Retire! You retiring would be the greatest contribution you could ever make to the LPL! You got a third chance, and what happened? As the first seed, you went 0-3 without winning a single game and got sent packing straight to the group stage exit. Don't let me see you in the LPL next season; if any team signs you, I'll be your hater for life.

notes.context: Refers to the League of Legends World Championship.
Nickname for coach Homme, derived from his name.
A derogatory fan nickname for Gumayusi, sounding similar to his name in Chinese.
Chinese fan slang for playing too passively, cowardly, or lacking aggression.
The actual given name of ADC player JackeyLove, used affectionately by fans.

thread.zh:
在S1～S15（旧小组赛双循环赛制），LPL、LCK没有任何一支队伍世界赛正赛一把没赢就出局。
S8的Gen.G（三星）是LCK历史下限：1胜5负，至少拿下1个BO1胜场。LPL往年最差比如S5 LGD、S7 EDG、S11 FPX，全都有胜场。
直到 S16 今天的 AL，才出现中韩赛区第一支【大场0胜、小局全输出局】的队伍。
甚至我们把范围扩大，不局限于 s 赛，算上 msi，先锋赛，石油杯，AL 也是第一支一把不赢就回家的[破防]
thread.en: From S1 to S15 (the old group stage format), no LPL or LCK team had ever been eliminated from the main event without winning a single game. Gen.G (Samsung) in S8 was the LCK's historical low: 1-5, but at least they took one BO1 win. The worst LPL performances in previous years, like S5 LGD, S7 EDG, or S11 FPX, all had wins. It wasn't until S16 today with AL that we finally saw the first team from the Chinese/Korean regions to go 0-0 in series and 0-X in games. If we expand the scope beyond Worlds to include MSI, the Esports World Cup, and the Saudi Cup, AL is still the first team to go home without a single win.

thread.en: The bot lane was already doomed, they were down 20 CS at 6 minutes. Then Nocturne and Annie had to force a chaotic fight in the bot river just to get Jinx a kill. I feel like Nocturne going in alone is just too thin; Annie can't keep up (and I don't think it would matter if she did), Tahm Kench has to protect that 'master' in the bot lane, and Olaf is nowhere to be found. Not to mention, when TES takes Nocturne, they always have Youshen's Orianna carrying the ball, or 69's Ambessa diving in. This Nocturne flies in and realizes he's all alone, so what's he supposed to do? Expect him to solo-kill a fed Xayah with her ult up? Or kill an Akali with a shroud? He definitely has some blame for the top 16 exit, but looking at Tarzan's form and league performance this year, what are the other 'masters' he's laning against doing, besides Shanks?

thread.zh: 事实证明双败赛制就是垃圾赛制，一个被3：0打输的队，第二条命复活了然后一路赢到决赛，然后手感火热的打等了半个月的没有手感的胜者，然后胜者输了就输了没有第二条命，这不是明显不合理吗，你要搞双败你就搞到底，硬性规定每队都有两条命，不用完不算输，要么你就把别搞这烂双败，换单败还能看得刺激点
thread.en: Facts have proven that the double-elimination format is just garbage. A team gets 3-0'd, gets a second life, wins all the way to the finals, and then has to face a hot team that's been waiting for half a month with zero momentum, and if the winner loses they just lose with no second life. Isn't that obviously unreasonable? If you're gonna do double-elimination then commit to it and make a strict rule that every team gets two lives and it's not over until they're used up, or else ditch this garbage double-elimination and switch back to single-elimination so it's actually exciting to watch.

thread.en: Mainly because in LoL there aren't many advantages for coming from the upper bracket in double elimination, whereas in Valorant the upper bracket winner gets two bans and first pick on the map pool which is a huge advantage. LoL's upper bracket draft advantage is basically nothing.
